name: GammaRips
description: Nightly Combo A options dataset, 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots, and 3-day excursion outcome surfaces for AI agents. 9 MCP tools over the GammaRips pipeline: the curated 40–50 contract bullish call pool (Mid >= $1.00, OI >= 500, Delta 0.22–0.48, DTE 10–45, rv_iv_ratio) with a free 3-contract preview, point-in-time feature vectors, 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots, 3-day MFE/MAE outcome surfaces, minute/daily option price replay, VIX/VIX3M regime context, and methodology playbooks. Your agent builds the trade plan with you. No shared pick endpoint. Educational only. Not investment advice.

auth.instructions: Free tier (no key, no card): connect to https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp for the 3-contract pool preview (matching https://gammarips.com/signals), daily reports, methodology playbooks, regime context, and market calendar. Pro tier ($29/mo founding price for the first 100 subscribers, $39/mo after, 30-day free trial at https://gammarips.com/pricing): unlocks the full 40–50 contract daily Combo A dataset, 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots, and 3-day outcome history via (1) OAuth 2.1 at https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro or (2) 'Authorization: Bearer gr_live_...' API key generated at https://gammarips.com/account.

universe: about 3,500 optionable US stocks, filtered nightly to the top 100 liquid universe and bullish calls passing Combo A gates (Mid >= $1.00, OI >= 500, Delta 0.22–0.48, DTE 10–45)
